purpose: Reviewer queue for the 36 historical change candidates. This is not a validated benchmark corpus and intentionally contains no ground-truth labels.
reviewPolicy: Two distinct non-conflicted reviewers must annotate each case independently and blindly using ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md. Do not expose OIOL outputs. Preserve evidence and disagreements; adjudicate where required.
forbiddenPrepopulation: Historical PR changed paths are intentionally omitted from this worklist and must not be copied into ground truth without independent evidence-based reasoning.
